title: Email signature / graphic text alternatives
slide_intent: Provide a text counterpart to a graphic so recipients can understand its role when they cannot see it.
strategic_value: Explicit setup guidance can help DB employees make signatures more accessible.
demonstration: Two expanded numbered procedures explain alternative text for the sleeper and for general graphics, with optional links and an example resizing step in the general procedure.
practical_value: Identify the graphic’s purpose before writing its text alternative and distinguish the sleeper-specific instructions from general image handling.

content_islands.name: Sleeper procedure
content_islands.spec: Present the four-step existing-image procedure and its prescribed description first.

content_islands.name: General graphics procedure
content_islands.spec: Follow with insertion, example scaling, concise description, optional text/link, default selection and saving.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says the procedures help recipients understand signature information.
reference_purposes.Application: Numbered instructions show how to edit image alternatives in the signature settings.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The sleeper procedure prescribes a specific alternative-text description; general graphics receive a concise content description.

ingredient.name: Signature graphic text alternative
ingredient.role: Explain a graphic’s role to recipients who cannot see it.
ingredient.application: Follow the source’s sleeper-specific procedure or describe the content of a general graphic concisely.
ingredient.scope: This records DB’s own instruction, including a nonempty description for the decorative sleeper; it is not a universal accessibility prescription. The 80% size in the general procedure is an example, not a brand-wide scale rule.
